title: Founder inspiration
description: A person who inspires the founder, and what about them invokes the founder's zeal (founders/<handle>/inspirations/<id>.json). A public figure may be named; a private person is an opaque id whose name sits in founders/<handle>/_private/.

name.description: Only for a public figure. A private person has no name here

public.description: true = a public figure, named; false = a private person, opaque

zeal.description: What about them invokes the founder's zeal, in the founder's own words
